messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: Unhandled Exception: Missing Dependency 'lattice' for package sp.
parts:
Anthony,

I think you're being hit by a bug that was fixed a few weeks back. Can you please update the following packages and try again:

devtools::install_github('rstudio/packrat')
devtools::install_github('rstudio/rsconnect')
devtools::install_github('rstudio/shinyapps')

Best,
-Andy

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: Unhandled Exception: Missing Dependency 'lattice' for package sp.
parts:
Anthony,

An application deployed to shinyapps.io can not access a file on your local computer. You must include the file in the application bundle by placing in the same directory as your ui.R and server.R.

Cheers,
-Andy
